ops.newText: the balance of which shall be divided by two; provided, that in no event shall the Termination Payment exceed an amount equal to the aggregate fees payable by the Company to HDI pursuant to Section 3.1 for the three (3) months immediately preceding the Termination Date.

input.comment: [Playbook] We capped the Termination Payment at three months' fees, since as drafted it is an uncapped share of Net Sales that operates as a penalty on a routine non-renewal. Our playbook position is termination for convenience without penalty; the three-month cap is our fallback and reflects HDI's build investment.
input.summary: Cap the Company's Termination Payment at three months' fees.
